Description: Configure Business Logic for VPMReference objects to automatically set the VversionComment attribute to 'Test Value'. Upon user edit, enforce a minimum character limit of 20.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Business Logic must trigger to set VversionComment to 'Test Value' by default.
When a user edits the attribute, a validation rule (e.g., PLMAttributesValuationCheck) must be triggered.
The rule must evaluate the input length using the String.Length() function.
If the input is less than 20 characters, the script must stop execution and prompt the user with an error using the Message or Notify keyword
Dependency: Data Setup application Access; VPMReference object schema availability
